connection.QXdzVGV4dHJhY3RSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: A connection to [AWS Textract](https://aws.amazon.com/textract/) for document text and structure extraction via SigV4-signed REST calls.  Inherits all AWS credential modes from AwsRestConnection (static keys, env vars, ECS task-role, IMDSv2, STS AssumeRole). The ping authenticates with `ListAdapters` and requires `textract:ListAdapters`; an authorization denial is reported as a failure.
connection.QXdzVGV4dHJhY3RSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: Spojenie s [AWS Textract](https://aws.amazon.com/textract/) na extrakciu textu a štruktúry dokumentov prostredníctvom podpísaných REST volaní SigV4. Deduje všetky režimy overenia AWS z AwsRestConnection (pevné kľúče, premenné prostredia, úloha ECS, IMDSv2, STS AssumeRole). Ping overuje pomocou `ListAdapters` a vyžaduje `textract:ListAdapters`; odmietnutie oprávnenia je hlásené ako chyba.
